patch_description: Replaces the current XX-and-RZ trajectory with the stronger readout-aligned ZZ architecture, then interleaves a YY interaction immediately after every ZZ interaction using the same collective parameter. This creates complementary, noncommuting correlation processing at zero parameter cost. The Möbius CZ backbone retains global propagation, while final CRZ gates align the learned transformation with the dataset’s measured pairs. The circuit still has only one distinct ansatz parameter and three total trainable parameters.
